name: 3-Pin Slider Switch (SPDT)
description: Single-Pole Double-Throw miniature slide switch for toggling power or selecting between two operational circuit modes.
realWorldAnalogy: Single-Pole Double-Throw miniature slide switch for toggling power or selecting between two operational circuit modes.
wiringGuidance: Connect center pin to Arduino digital input with INPUT_PULLUP enabled. Connect outer pin 1 to GND. When slid toward pin 1, input reads LOW.
commonMistakes: Leaving center pin floating when using external voltage instead of pull-up resistors.
Forcing the plastic slider knob with excessive force.

miniExperiment.title: A/B Mode Selector
miniExperiment.circuit: Pin 2 (Common) to Pin 7 (INPUT_PULLUP), Pin 1 to GND, Pin 3 open.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor updates the operational mode message whenever the slider is flipped.
